strategy_version: BTC+ETH Macro Hedge V3.8 - V3.1 Shadow Engine + 3-Completed-Close AHR Execution Overlay

models.H0: Initial allocation only; no DCA; no tactical trading
models.K: Independent V3.1 shadow plus three-completed-close AHR execution overlay

shadow_engine.implementation: separately executed unmodified V3.1 FSM-only engine

execution_overlay.cooldown_boundary: sell signal close is close zero; the next three newly available completed daily closes are all blocked; eligible only from the first tradable bar after the third subsequent close, when the fourth subsequent daily signal is available
execution_overlay.pending_condition: completed AHR999 <= V3.1 threshold and V3.1 shadow remains in BEAR, DEEP_BEAR, or ACCUMULATION
execution_overlay.bar_execution_order: original V3.1 tactical order, then original V3.1 DCA order; if risk sell and AHR coexist, risk sell first and AHR cannot execute at that timestamp

operational_interpretations.shadow_action_source: executed tactical-event groups from the independent original V3.1 shadow trade ledger at the current timestamp only
operational_interpretations.completed_close_counter: increments only when a new completed daily signal becomes available after the risk-sell signal; resets to zero on every new risk sell
operational_interpretations.zero_notional_risk_sell: NO_TRADE_ALREADY_BELOW_TARGET with EXECUTE decision; unchanged target and not suppression
operational_interpretations.pending_recheck_frequency: once per newly available completed daily signal
operational_interpretations.pending_target: the original shadow AHR desired exposure target
operational_interpretations.multiple_delayed_requests: one pending order may retain multiple delayed shadow-request audit records; each record receives the eventual execution or cancellation outcome
operational_interpretations.temporary_cash: V3.1 temporary-lot ownership and unwind events are mirrored for actual execution only and never feed the shadow FSM
operational_interpretations.new_bull_budget: actual tactical cash divided by the current original V3.1 redeploy steps remaining
operational_interpretations.opportunity_forward_returns: post-backtest reporting only; BTC open at the original shadow execution compared with BTC close exactly 30 and 60 calendar days later when available
operational_interpretations.implementation_correction: invalidated preliminary attempt 1 because it incorrectly allowed AHR on the third subsequent completed close; corrected to block closes one through three and allow only from day four; no strategy parameter or gate changed
